# API Requirements Checklist: Website Enquiry API

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing on the public enquiry method and UTM Source seed
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are required Lead fields specified (name and mobile)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is Contact vs Medical Tourism distinction specified as UTM Source values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is seed idempotency specified for the two UTM Source rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is guest-without-token success specified for the write method? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Is “stricter than catalog reads” quantified relative to 60/minute? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is visitor note storage specified given Lead.notes is a child table? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Does “no new DocType” stay consistent with using CRM Lead and UTM Source? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Constitution II]
- [ ] CHK008 Do optional tourism extras not become required on the method? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are missing-field and invalid-email non-insert scenarios specified? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is duplicate-email behavior specified so a second enquiry still becomes a Lead? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is unmatched Country text specified as note storage rather than insert failure? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is unknown `source` specified as validation without insert? [Edge Case, Spec §Contract]

## Non-Functional / Auth

- [ ] CHK013 Is permission bypass specified for Guest Lead insert? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Is rate limiting specified as applying to abusive traffic while a single valid post still succeeds? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002]
